Core of the list is going fast and breaking things. All mounted units have 13-14" move base, access to auto advance 6, and a strat to make a normal move or fall back in either fight phase if they fought. So the Wulfen unit with the captain on Bike moves 19", charges, and then moves another 13" after hitting something with 25 Thunder hammers with Cleave

The Wulfen and T Cav have Lethal Hits against Characters, Vehicles, and Monsters and access to an Uppy Downy within 9" of a board edge (strat reserves, no deep strike). Defensively, I have AoC or 3/4+ Fight on Death (depending on doctrine) for anyone, a Blood Surge strat for Wulfen and Cav, and a -1 to hit in shooting for Mounted. Offensively, multiple Lance strats, one of which gives extra AP in Assault. And of course in Assault Brethern I can advance and charge twice. Please ask questions, and hope to have great games.
